 [connection master]

 CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
 [connection slave]
-include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc [errno=1142]
+include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc [errno=1044]

diff --git a/mysql-test/suite/rpl/r/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.result b/mysql-test/suite/rpl/r/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.result
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..5d1bc29617a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mysql-test/suite/rpl/r/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.result
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+#
+# 1. Set up the initial source-replica configuration.
+include/master-slave.inc
+Warnings:
+Note	####	Sending passwords in plain text without SSL/TLS is extremely insecure.
+Note	####	Storing MySQL user name or password information in the connection metadata repository is not secure and is therefore not recommended. Please consider using the USER and PASSWORD connection options for START REPLICA; see the 'START REPLICA Syntax' in the MySQL Manual for more information.
+[connection master]
+#
+# 2. Set `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` to a user without `CREATE` and `DROP`
+#    privileges and start replica.
+[connection slave]
+CALL mtr.add_suppression("Access denied for user.*to database.*");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*The replica coordinator and worker threads are stopped.*");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*Replica: Unknown database.*");
+CREATE USER 'u1'@'localhost';
+GRANT SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN, REPLICATION_APPLIER ON *.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+RESET REPLICA ALL;
+CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_USER='root', SOURCE_PORT=MY_MASTER_PORT, SOURCE_HOST='127.0.0.1', PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER='u1'@'localhost', REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT = 1, SOURCE_LOG_POS=MY_MASTER_LOG_POS;
+Warnings:
+Note	1759	Sending passwords in plain text without SSL/TLS is extremely insecure.
+Note	1760	Storing MySQL user name or password information in the connection metadata repository is not secure and is therefore not recommended. Please consider using the USER and PASSWORD connection options for START REPLICA; see the 'START REPLICA Syntax' in the MySQL Manual for more information.
+START REPLICA;
+#
+# 3. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on
+#    db1 on the source.
+[connection master]
+CREATE DATABASE db1;
+USE db1;
+CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
+DROP TABLE t1;
+DROP DATABASE db1;
+#
+# 4. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+[connection slave]
+include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc [errno=1044]
+include/stop_slave.inc
+#
+# 5. Grant database-specific `CREATE` and `DROP` privileges to the
+#    specified user, resume replication, and verify that it succeeds.
+GRANT CREATE, DROP ON db1.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+include/start_slave.inc
+[connection master]
+include/sync_slave_sql_with_master.inc
+#
+# 6. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on
+#    db2 on the source.
+[connection master]
+CREATE DATABASE db2;
+USE db2;
+CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
+DROP TABLE t1;
+DROP DATABASE db2;
+#
+# 7. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+[connection slave]
+include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc [errno=1044]
+include/stop_slave.inc
+#
+# 8. Create a role with CREATE and DROP privileges on db2, grant it to
+#    the specified user, set it as the default role, start replication
+#    and verify the changes replicate successfully to the replica.
+CREATE ROLE role1;
+GRANT role1 TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+SET DEFAULT ROLE role1 TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+GRANT CREATE, DROP ON db2.* TO role1;
+include/start_slave.inc
+[connection master]
+include/sync_slave_sql_with_master.inc
+#
+# 9. On the source, perform a CREATE operation on a different database.
+[connection master]
+CREATE DATABASE db3;
+#
+# 10. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+[connection slave]
+include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc [errno=1044]
+#
+# 11. Clean up
+[connection master]
+DROP DATABASE db3;
+[connection slave]
+DROP ROLE role1;
+DROP USER 'u1'@'localhost';
+include/stop_slave.inc
+CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER=NULL, REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT=0 FOR CHANNEL '';
+START REPLICA;
+include/rpl_end.inc

+++ b/mysql-test/suite/rpl/t/rpl_change_master_to_priv_checks_user_errors.test
@@ -97,7 +97,8 @@ GRANT SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN, REPLICATION_APPLIER ON *.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
 #
 # 1) Set `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` to a user without `CREATE` privileges.
 #
-CALL mtr.add_suppression(".CREATE command denied to user.");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression("Access denied for user.*to database.*");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*Replica: Unknown database.*");
 
 RESET SLAVE ALL;
 
@@ -113,13 +114,15 @@ START SLAVE;
 # 2) Create a table on the master.
 #
 --source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+CREATE DATABASE db1;
+USE db1;
 CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
 
 #
 # 3) Wait for slave to error out.
 #
 --source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
---let $slave_sql_errno = convert_error(ER_TABLEACCESS_DENIED_ERROR)
+--let $slave_sql_errno = convert_error(ER_DBACCESS_DENIED_ERROR)

@@ -195,7 +198,7 @@ CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*Access denied. you need .at least one of. the GRANT
 if (`SELECT @@GLOBAL.GTID_MODE = "ON"`)
 {
   --disable_query_log
-  --eval SET GTID_NEXT= '$master_uuid:2'
+  --eval SET GTID_NEXT= '$master_uuid:3'
   BEGIN;
   COMMIT;
   SET GTID_NEXT= 'AUTOMATIC';
@@ -226,6 +229,7 @@ GRANT DROP ON *.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
 START SLAVE;
 --source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
 DROP TABLE t1;
+DROP DATABASE db1;
 --source include/sync_slave_sql_with_master.inc
 --source include/stop_slave.inc
 CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER=NULL, REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT=0 FOR CHANNEL '';
diff --git a/mysql-test/suite/rpl/t/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.test b/mysql-test/suite/rpl/t/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.test
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..615d3c6217c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mysql-test/suite/rpl/t/rpl_priv_checks_user_db_specific_access.test
@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+##############################################################################
+# ==== Purpose ====
+# This script tests database-specific CREATE and DROP access handling
+# with respect to the `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` option of
+# `CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO.. `.
+#
+# ==== Requirements ====
+# Replication must succeed for the respective CREATE or DROP operations
+# when the user specified in the `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` option of
+# `CHANGEASTER REPLICATION SOURCE TO ...` has database-specific privileges to
+# perform those operations.
+#
+# ==== Implementation ====
+# 1. Set up the initial source-replica configuration.
+# 2. Set `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` to a user without `CREATE` and `DROP`
+#    privileges and start replica.
+# 3. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on
+#    db1 on the source.
+# 4. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+# 5. Grant database-specific `CREATE` and `DROP` privileges to the specified
+#    user, resume replication, and verify that it succeeds.
+# 6. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on db2 on
+#    the source.
+# 7. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+# 8. Create a role with CREATE and DROP privileges on db2, grant it to the
+#    specified user, set it as the default role, start replication and verify
+#    the changes replicate successfully to the replica.
+# 9. On the source, perform a CREATE operation on a different database.
+# 10. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+# 11. Clean up.
+#
+# ==== References ====
+# Bug#37587555:PRIVILEGE CHECK FAILS FOR CREATE, DROP WHEN IT IS GRANTED
+#              TO A SPECIFIC DATABASE
+##############################################################################
+
+--source include/have_binlog_format_row.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 1. Set up the initial source-replica configuration.
+--let $rpl_skip_start_slave = 1
+--source include/master-slave.inc
+
+--let $source_log_pos = query_get_value(SHOW MASTER STATUS, Position, 1)
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 2. Set `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` to a user without `CREATE` and `DROP`
+--echo #    privileges and start replica.
+--source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
+CALL mtr.add_suppression("Access denied for user.*to database.*");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*The replica coordinator and worker threads are stopped.*");
+CALL mtr.add_suppression(".*Replica: Unknown database.*");
+
+CREATE USER 'u1'@'localhost';
+GRANT SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN, REPLICATION_APPLIER ON *.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+
+RESET REPLICA ALL;
+--replace_result $MASTER_MYPORT MY_MASTER_PORT $source_log_pos MY_MASTER_LOG_POS
+--eval CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_USER='root', SOURCE_PORT=$MASTER_MYPORT, SOURCE_HOST='127.0.0.1', PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER='u1'@'localhost', REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT = 1, SOURCE_LOG_POS=$source_log_pos
+START REPLICA;
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 3. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on
+--echo #    db1 on the source.
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+CREATE DATABASE db1;
+USE db1;
+CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
+DROP TABLE t1;
+DROP DATABASE db1;
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 4. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+--source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
+--let $slave_sql_errno = convert_error(ER_DBACCESS_DENIED_ERROR)
+--source include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc
+--source include/stop_slave.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 5. Grant database-specific `CREATE` and `DROP` privileges to the
+--echo #    specified user, resume replication, and verify that it succeeds.
+GRANT CREATE, DROP ON db1.* TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+--source include/start_slave.inc
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+--source include/sync_slave_sql_with_master.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 6. Execute CREATE and DROP operations (e.g., database and table) on
+--echo #    db2 on the source.
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+CREATE DATABASE db2;
+USE db2;
+CREATE TABLE t1 (c1 INT);
+DROP TABLE t1;
+DROP DATABASE db2;
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 7. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+--source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
+--let $slave_sql_errno = convert_error(ER_DBACCESS_DENIED_ERROR)
+--source include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc
+--source include/stop_slave.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 8. Create a role with CREATE and DROP privileges on db2, grant it to
+--echo #    the specified user, set it as the default role, start replication
+--echo #    and verify the changes replicate successfully to the replica.
+CREATE ROLE role1;
+GRANT role1 TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+SET DEFAULT ROLE role1 TO 'u1'@'localhost';
+GRANT CREATE, DROP ON db2.* TO role1;
+--source include/start_slave.inc
+
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+--source include/sync_slave_sql_with_master.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 9. On the source, perform a CREATE operation on a different database.
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+CREATE DATABASE db3;
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 10. Wait for the replica to encounter an "access denied" error.
+--source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
+--let $slave_sql_errno = convert_error(ER_DBACCESS_DENIED_ERROR)
+--source include/wait_for_slave_sql_error.inc
+
+--echo #
+--echo # 11. Clean up
+--source include/rpl_connection_master.inc
+DROP DATABASE db3;
+--source include/rpl_connection_slave.inc
+DROP ROLE role1;
+DROP USER 'u1'@'localhost';
+--source include/stop_slave.inc
+CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER=NULL, REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT=0 FOR CHANNEL '';
+START REPLICA;
+--source include/rpl_end.inc
problem_statement:
MySQL Bug 37587555: replication rejects database-specific CREATE and DROP grants.

A replication channel uses PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER. CREATE and DROP fail their privilege checks when the applier user holds those privileges at database scope rather than global scope. Applicable database grants and later changes to them should be honored when the replication event executes.
